preregistration.expected_outcome:
Does not outperform. On the development slices at "auto" the composite flagged 2.3x
(KDD), 5.2x (Covertype) and 20x (card fraud) the review budget, with wrong flags 2.1x and
4.4x the budget on KDD and Covertype, and lower flag F1 on card fraud (-0.05). Its flag
F1 was higher on KDD and Covertype only because it flags many more rows.
preregistration.hypothesis:
composite-agreement-real-v1 was judged with both policies at each dataset's review budget.
This tests the shipped scoring.contamination = "auto": does composite-agreement@1 still
outperform intersection@1 on the same datasets when both run at "auto", judged against
the same review budgets (decision rule 2, with ranking)?
